article.title: Gopuff接入Grok Bot，讓顧客在對話內確認雜貨訂單
article.title_en: Gopuff connects to Grok Bot for in-chat grocery checkout
article.summary: Gopuff稱顧客連接帳戶後，可在同一對話選商品、檢查購物車及結帳。
article.summary_en: Gopuff says customers can link an account, choose items, review the cart and check out in the same conversation.
highlights: 使用前須登入或建立Gopuff帳戶。
公司稱商品選擇按可用庫存組成，顧客仍需確認訂單。
highlights_en: Customers need to sign in or create a Gopuff account.
Gopuff says orders use available inventory and still require customer confirmation.
article.why: 零售團隊可檢查商品資料、庫存和付款確認能否在對話入口保持一致。
article.why_en: Retail teams can check whether product data, inventory and checkout stay consistent in a conversational entry point.
article.next_step: 先畫出一個從商品查詢到訂單確認的流程，標明缺貨、付款及售後責任。
article.next_step_en: Map one journey from product enquiry to order confirmation, including stockouts, payments and support.
article.detail: 對話入口把商品搜尋、購物車和付款確認放在同一流程。Gopuff表示，價格、庫存與配送時段來自自家系統。這對品牌的啟示是，商品內容與實際履約資料要能對上。評估類似接入時，可先檢查缺貨替代、結帳金額及售後入口，再決定是否擴展至更多商品和市場。也可記下付款失敗時如何回復購物車。
article.detail_en: The connector brings product search, cart review and payment confirmation into one flow. Gopuff says prices, stock and delivery windows come from its own systems. Check substitutions, final charges and support before expanding to more products or markets. Record how a shopper can recover the cart after a payment failure.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
